https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/6304e9f87634a1a3685ed73798dcd312f57efb55

Starting with this commit, build artifacts cause the editor to crash when opening my glb file in the preview window.

Crash tace seems to be unrelated to this accessibility commit, but just in case please try running the following commands and post the output here:

```
dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:IsEnabled

dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:ScreenReaderEnabled
```

```
[kanamori@sayaka ~]$ dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:IsEnabled
method return time=1766918333.857302 sender=:1.20 -> destination=:1.102 serial=441 reply_serial=2
   variant       boolean false
[kanamori@sayaka ~]$ dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:ScreenReaderEnabled
method return time=1766918353.090292 sender=:1.20 -> destination=:1.103 serial=442 reply_serial=2
   variant       boolean false
```

This is the expected result, both `false` means system correctly report screen reader as disabled (which some distros/configs seems to fail to do). This makes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/6304e9f87634a1a3685ed73798dcd312f57efb55 even less likely to be the real cause, since accessibility related code should not be called at all.
